title: Agent DAG supervised implementation template
objective: Demonstrate a reusable supervised implementation DAG: contract → parallel scouts → plan → write-set audit → write-set gate → implement → soft verify → process supervisor → repair → hard verify → review verdict → review gate → decision gate → closeout. Write-set, process, and review verdict nodes emit first-line VERDICT for deterministic gates, reducing main-session intervention.
successCriteria: contract-pi returns a read-only implementation contract with narrow write boundaries
scout-src and scout-tests run in parallel without write conflicts
plan-pi produces a writeSet coverage matrix with explicit exclusive owners
write-set-audit-pi validates coverage and returns VERDICT pass or request-revision
write-set-gate-shell blocks implement-pi unless write-set-audit-pi first-line VERDICT is pass
implement-pi and repair-pi write only inside declared writeSet
soft-verify-shell archives focused test exit codes before process supervision
process-supervisor-pi returns first-line VERDICT pass or request-revision
process-gate-shell deterministically accepts valid supervisor verdicts
hard-verify-shell archives lint/typecheck/focused tests with active-DAG governance when check-repo runs
review-pi returns first-line VERDICT using review verdict prompt invariants
review-gate-shell blocks downstream nodes unless review VERDICT is pass
decision-pi returns DECISION_ENVELOPE_JSON without pausing runtime by default
closeout-pi summarizes evidence without writing files
globalConstraints: Replace every REPLACE/WITH/... placeholder with concrete repo paths before execution; do not leave template placeholders in production DAG JSON.
Do not commit from DAG nodes; main session inspects and commits after Decision Gate approval.
Use only existing executors: pi, shell, static; cursor is optional when explicitly enabled. Pi writer nodes must set toolProfile=write.
Read-only nodes must not write repository files, including root artifacts/**.
Exclusive writer nodes must stay within declared writeSet.
Do not implement automatic retry/resume or mutate historical completed facts.
Do not create executor: supervisor; supervisor is a role on executor=pi.
Do not create executor: human, executor: decision, or browser executor.
Shell governance inside active DAG must use HARNESS_ALLOW_ACTIVE_DAG_RUNS=1 bash scripts/check-repo.sh.
On Windows, Bash script commands must run through Git Bash or a configured compatible Bash; do not require WSL or POSIX filesystem paths.
Actual file operation paths must be macOS/Windows compatible; use / only for stable repo refs, JSON/Markdown evidence refs, and glob conventions.
Prompt templates must not ask main session to write artifacts; node output is the artifact and runner archives it under .harness/dag-runs/.
Every task must explicitly declare executor; defaults.executor is schema-only and not a runtime fallback.
Prefer same-rank parallel read-only scouts over serial chains when outputs are independent.
Same-rank exclusive writeSet entries must be disjoint.
Use executorModels for model routing; do not add defaults.model or legacy top-level models.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown implementation contract: scope, risks, parallel scout opportunities, verification expectations. No file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Read the DAG objective and success criteria. Return a concise implementation contract covering scope, narrow write boundaries, risks, and verification expectations. Do not edit files or write root artifacts/**.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown source reconnaissance summary; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Perform read-only source reconnaissance under allowedPaths. List relevant files, patterns, and risks. Do not edit files.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown test coverage reconnaissance summary; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Perform read-only test reconnaissance under allowedPaths. List relevant tests, coverage gaps, and focused verification commands. Do not edit files.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown plan with WriteSet Coverage Matrix (file → owning exclusive node id). No file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Synthesize upstream scouts into an implementation plan. Include a WriteSet Coverage Matrix table mapping each file that must change to exactly one future exclusive implementer/repair node id. Flag parallel work and verification commands. Do not edit files.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown whose first non-empty line is VERDICT: pass or VERDICT: request-revision; includes writeSet coverage findings. No file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Audit plan-pi WriteSet Coverage Matrix against the contract. First non-empty line must be exactly VERDICT: pass or VERDICT: request-revision. List Critical/Important gaps when any required file lacks a single exclusive owner or overlaps forbidden paths. Do not edit files or write root artifacts/**.

tasks.outputContract: Deterministic write-set audit verdict gate: exit 0 only when write-set-audit-pi first non-empty assistant output line is pass.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Deterministic gate: block implement-pi unless write-set-audit-pi emitted VERDICT: pass.

tasks.outputContract: Implementation summary with changed files, focused tests run, and risks. Must not ask main session to write artifacts.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Implement the approved change within writeSet only after write-set-gate-shell passed (upstream VERDICT: pass). If write-set gate blocked, output blocked reason without editing files. Keep changes minimal and run focused tests inside allowedPaths when implementing.

tasks.outputContract: Archived shell stdout/stderr with exit codes for focused verification; no worktree writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Run focused soft verification before process supervision.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown whose first non-empty line is VERDICT: pass or VERDICT: request-revision, followed by a REPAIR_ARTIFACT_JSON fenced block. Audit writeSet coverage, boundary drift, verification gaps, repair scope. No file writes.
Deterministic process supervisor verdict gate: exit 0 when first non-empty assistant output line is pass or request-revision; exit non-zero otherwise.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Deterministic gate: validate process-supervisor-pi first-line VERDICT before repair/hard-verify.

tasks.outputContract: Repair summary or explicit no-op when process supervisor passed; changed files and tests when revised. Must not ask main session to write artifacts.
tasks.subtask_prompt: If process-supervisor-pi returned VERDICT: request-revision, apply bounded fixes within writeSet addressing REPAIR_ARTIFACT_JSON.fixScope and preserving REPAIR_ARTIFACT_JSON.invariant. Use REPAIR_ARTIFACT_JSON.failureClass and rootCause before raw logs; raw log is fallback evidence only when rawLogFallbackAllowed is true. If VERDICT: pass, return no-op with evidence. Re-run focused tests when you change code.

tasks.outputContract: Archived hard verification stdout/stderr with exit codes; no worktree writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Run hard verification after repair round.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown whose first non-empty line is VERDICT: pass or VERDICT: request-revision; Critical/Important findings force request-revision. No file writes.
Deterministic review verdict gate: exit 0 only when review-pi first non-empty assistant output line is pass.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Deterministic gate: block decision gate unless review-pi emitted VERDICT: pass.

tasks.outputContract: Markdown with exactly one DECISION_ENVELOPE_JSON fenced block plus evidence summary. No file writes.
Plain Markdown closeout referencing verification, supervisor/review verdicts, and decision envelope. No file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Summarize the supervised DAG outcome: contract, write-set audit, implement/repair, soft/hard verify, process supervisor and review verdicts, decision-pi envelope, and recommended main-session next step. Do not edit files or write root artifacts/**.
